findings.title: Eksikliği gideren yeterlilik
findings.claim: The focus presents enrichment as the creation of workable capacity in response to an identified lack, so the result can include being made able to manage life rather than receiving luxury alone.
findings.mechanism: The poverty carrier in عَآئِلًا meets the sufficiency carrier in أَغْنَىٰ, while the wider 24:32 need-to-enrichment connection activates the qualified و ج د capacity facet in وَجَدَكَ as a structural recognition-to-repair relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The change makes the response feel like a precise answer to a named deficiency: what was found in need is made able to function, not merely moved into abundance.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of material enrichment remains recoverable. The Form I وَجَدَكَ still means finding or recognizing; the qualified capacity branch is an analogical contribution and does not turn it into a causative wealth verb.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run evidence is trusted and strongly anchored, but the و ج د capacity branch is qualified and the external connection supplies target text without target morphology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: varlıklı veya yeterli olmak; varlıklı ya da güçlü kılmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Belirli yapılarda bir şeye erişebilecek veya onu yapabilecek güce ve yeterli imkana sahip olmak.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form I finding in وَجَدَكَ carries attentive recognition of the addressed person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:32 connection pairs poverty with divine enrichment as an external need-to-sufficiency movement.
branch_activations.activation: The external repair pattern meets the focus finding before its result, allowing the finding to be heard as recognition of a state that can be made capable; this is a structural analogy, not a replacement for the local finding sense.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: وَوَجَدَكَ ... فَأَغْنَىٰ can show a lack being discerned and capability being made present, not luxury alone.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus verb remains Form I finding/recognition, and the activation does not claim that وَجَدَكَ itself means to enrich.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, geçim araçlarının yetersizliği yüzünden yoksulluk ve gereksinim içinde bulunmaktır.
branch_activations.carrier: عَآئِلًا carries the lived condition of poverty and need.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:32 connection gives a wider poverty-followed-by-divine-enrichment parallel.
branch_activations.activation: The external parallel makes the focus's needy state a concrete deficiency that the following response answers with capacity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The enrichment responds to an actual lack named by the focus, rather than adding unbounded prosperity imagery.
branch_activations.boundary: This activation uses the poverty facet, not the separate dependents, horse, or directionless-animal branches.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İhtiyaçların bulunmaması ya da az olması, maddi bollukla birlikte çekirdeğin bir parçasıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَغْنَىٰ carries the completed response of reduced need and material sufficiency.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 24:32 connection independently repeats the movement from poverty into divine enrichment.
branch_activations.activation: The external movement meets the focus's resultative response, making the reduced-need aspect of enrichment answer the poverty carrier as workable capacity.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: أَغْنَىٰ can be heard as removing the named need and giving sufficient means, while its material sense remains present.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not assert every available wealth association or a guarantee of permanent worldly surplus.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ihtiyacı karşılayıp yarar sağlama ve yerini tutma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir unsur, başka bir kişi veya durum için yeterli olur ve ihtiyacı karşılar.
branch_activations.carrier: أَغْنَىٰ carries an effective sufficiency that meets a need.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider 24:32 connection supplies an independent need-to-enrichment relation returning to this focus.
branch_activations.activation: The external parallel activates the response as functional sufficiency in contact with عَآئِلًا, so the result answers a condition rather than merely naming a possession.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The one found needy is made sufficient for the identified need, with usefulness and capacity visible alongside material relief.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding is not a claim that every later social consequence is already explicit in this one clause.

findings.title: Başkalarının yükünü taşıyabilen yeterlilik
findings.claim: The sufficiency named in the focus can extend from relief of private need to the ability to carry the claims of people who depend on support.
findings.mechanism: The dependents facet in عَآئِلًا meets the sufficing-for-another facet in أَغْنَىٰ; the later orphan and asker in 93:9-10 and the wider vulnerable-person care connection provide independent triggers that turn sufficiency outward.
findings.reader_payoff: Enrichment becomes capacity with a social reach: the reader can see how being made sufficient may make one able to answer another person's need.
findings.containment: The material relief in the plain translation remains intact. The later sequence supplies a contextual extension toward carrying others; it does not turn this ayah alone into a complete legal command or erase the private dimension.

epistemic.reason: A trusted anchored finding and legacy reader-walk context agree on the mechanism, while the force of the ethical extension is contextual rather than grammatically forced.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, geçimi bir başkası tarafından üstlenilen kişi ya da bu kişilerin oluşturduğu topluluktur.

branch_activations.activation: The later vulnerable claimants meet the dependent facet in the focus, making the preceding lack relevant to an ability to carry others rather than only to private comfort.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The one made sufficient can be heard as made able to bear the needs of dependents and claimants.
branch_activations.boundary: The ayah does not state the full later command here, and this does not activate the unrelated movement, animal, or marriage branches of ع ي ل.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ihtiyacı karşılayıp yarar sağlama ve yerini tutma

branch_activations.resulting_reading: أَغْنَىٰ can include being made able to stand in for absent support and answer another person's claim.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual extension of the response, not a denial of material enrichment or a claim that every person receiving wealth must carry every burden.

findings.title: Yön, sığınak ve yerleşme
findings.claim: Within the focus's enrichment movement, need can also be colored as the condition of a directionless being, and sufficiency as arrival at a stable place and course after shelter and guidance.

findings.reader_payoff: The result is no longer only an economic change: being made sufficient can make a viable direction and settled ground perceptible alongside the plain relief of poverty.
findings.containment: The economic reading remains present. The focus verb is not equated lexically with shelter or dwelling, and this local cross-ayah configuration is not named as a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run finding is trusted and exact, while the shelter/course synthesis is a legacy reader inference with a nominated context branch and therefore remains qualified.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kurucu durum, yolunu yitirmiş hayvanın gideceği yönü belirleyememesidir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The needy condition can include lacking stable orientation, and enrichment can include the capacity to find and keep a viable course.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus does not literally name an animal or make the economic reading disappear.

findings.title: Alınan desteğin bakıma dönüşmesi
findings.claim: The one who is remembered as having needed support can be read as being prepared to become a non-oppressive support node for other vulnerable people.
findings.mechanism: The dependents facet in عَآئِلًا meets the later orphan/requester sequence and the wider requirement of provision with kind speech; the ethical reversal from having been supported to supporting others is an inference from that ordered contact.
findings.reader_payoff: Received sufficiency acquires a relational direction: support is not only something the addressee receives but a capacity that can protect another person's dignity.
findings.containment: The plain enrichment remains intact and the later commands are not imported as if already stated in 93:8. The ethical flow is exploratory and does not establish a necessary causal law from sequence alone.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and later contextual cues are supplied, but the movement from remembered dependence to ethical obligation is explicitly reader-supplied inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, geçimi bir başkası tarafından üstlenilen kişi ya da bu kişilerin oluşturduğu topluluktur.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied reader-walk sequence places an orphan and a requester in 93:9-10, and the 4:8 connection requires provision and kind speech for vulnerable people.
branch_activations.activation: The later vulnerable people meet the focus's dependent facet, allowing remembered dependence to become the structural occasion for care rather than domination or rebuke.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus can prepare the addressee to use received sufficiency as support that preserves another person's dignity.
branch_activations.boundary: The ethical reversal is an exploratory contextual inference; the focus does not explicitly state all later conduct in this clause.

findings.title: Sesle taşan yeterlilik
findings.claim: The sufficiency named by أَغْنَىٰ can also open into a voice capable of carrying and narrating favor.
findings.mechanism: The exact vocal-enrichment facet of غ ن ي is carried by أَغْنَىٰ and meets the later command to narrate blessing, with the supplied 26:84 speech connection providing an independent wider voice trigger.
findings.reader_payoff: Enrichment becomes expressive: what was received can become a speakable account rather than remaining only an unspoken material condition.
findings.containment: Material sufficiency remains the recoverable primary reading. The vocal facet is a qualified contextual resonance and does not claim that أَغْنَىٰ loses its wealth or sufficiency sense.

epistemic.reason: The exact B003 branch is supported by a trusted cross-run finding and a legacy reader-walk, while the external speech row is a weak authored connection with no target morphology.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sesle ezgi söyleme, dinleme ve ezgili okuma
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan sesiyle ezgi söyleme ve bu seslendirmeyi dinleme çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: أَغْنَىٰ carries the focus response whose wider vocal facet can become expressive sound.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 26:84 connection adds durable truthful speech, and the focus's later 93:11 context commands narration of blessing.
branch_activations.activation: The speech trigger meets the vocal facet of the focus response, making sufficiency intelligible as a condition that can overflow into voiced gratitude or truthful report.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Being made sufficient can include gaining an enriched voice with which favor becomes audible and reportable.
branch_activations.boundary: The target speech row supplies a voice trigger, not a target lexical analysis; this does not assert melody as the only or primary meaning.

findings.title: Yeterliliğin bildirilebilir nimete dönüşmesi
findings.claim: As the later ayahs arrive, the focus's enrichment shifts from an apparently private change into a favor that can be spoken about and reported.
findings.mechanism: The vocal facet of أَغْنَىٰ is carried by the focus word, while the supplied retrospective record uses 93:9-10 as the before/after trigger and 93:11 as the point where the changed condition becomes reportable.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the enrichment retrospectively: later vulnerable-person consequences make the response outward-facing, and the closing report turns that outward change into voiced favor.
findings.containment: This is a contextual before/after reading from the supplied retrospective walk. It supplements the material result and does not claim that the word means speech without the later sequence.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective record supplies an exact B003 focus branch and named later ayahs, but its synthesis is legacy_unbound and remains a qualified contextual inference.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sesle ezgi söyleme, dinleme ve ezgili okuma
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan sesiyle ezgi söyleme ve bu seslendirmeyi dinleme çekirdeği oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: أَغْنَىٰ carries the vocal-enrichment facet that becomes visible after the later sequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied retrospective record names the orphan/requester consequences in 93:9-10 and the reportable favor in 93:11.
branch_activations.activation: The later consequences change the apparent private enrichment into an outward process, and the 93:11 command gives that process a voice; the focus B003 facet is the return point.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The completed sufficiency can be heard as a favor prepared for truthful, voiced narration.
branch_activations.boundary: The before/after shift does not displace the economic result and does not claim that speech is grammatically encoded without context.

findings.title: Dışa dönük yeterlilik
findings.claim: Later orphan and requester consequences make the sufficiency in the focus outward-facing: it can mean enoughness that carries another person's claim and culminates in acknowledged favor.
findings.mechanism: The dependents facet in عَآئِلًا and the sufficing-for-another facet in أَغْنَىٰ are activated by the retrospective 93:9-11 sequence, which changes the reading from private accumulation toward support and reportable favor.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the enrichment matters beyond the recipient: sufficiency becomes a capacity that enters relation with other people's needs.
findings.containment: The material and personal result remains in place. This retrospective contextual shift does not make the later commands part of the syntax of 93:8, nor does it collapse the separate vocal finding into a single lexical meaning.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective source names the exact later ayahs and the B002 focus carrier, but its before/after synthesis is legacy_unbound and contextually inferred.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, geçimi bir başkası tarafından üstlenilen kişi ya da bu kişilerin oluşturduğu topluluktur.
branch_activations.carrier: عَآئِلًا carries the dependent or support-burden facet that becomes outward-facing in retrospect.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied retrospective record says that 93:9-10 place an orphan and an asker before the now-sufficed addressee and that 93:11 names the process as favor.
branch_activations.activation: Those later claimants meet the focus dependent facet, changing the felt direction of sufficiency from private accumulation to the ability to carry another's claim and acknowledge the source of favor.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The enrichment can be read as enoughness that becomes socially usable and publicly reportable.
branch_activations.boundary: The later social and expressive consequences are contextual extensions, not additional grammatical objects of أَغْنَىٰ.

findings.title: Alınan yeterlilik, kendini yeterli saymak değildir
findings.claim: The focus presents sufficiency as something granted to the addressed person, while the supplied global contrast with self-perceived sufficiency keeps that received capacity distinct from self-enclosure.
findings.mechanism: The sufficing-for-another facet of أَغْنَىٰ meets the supplied 96:7 connection, whose self-sufficiency contrast independently returns to the focus and changes the agency implied by enrichment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish being made sufficient from claiming independence: the response remains received capacity rather than a closed identity built from possession.
findings.containment: The external 96:7 target is used as a bounded contrast and not as a replacement gloss for the focus. Material enrichment remains live, and the target's unsupplied morphology prevents a more specific lexical claim.

epistemic.reason: The focus sufficiency branch and trusted capacity support are exact, while the target connection supplies authored contrast evidence without target morphology or a full target lexical record.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ihtiyacı karşılayıp yarar sağlama ve yerini tutma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir unsur, başka bir kişi veya durum için yeterli olur ve ihtiyacı karşılar.
branch_activations.carrier: أَغْنَىٰ carries granted sufficiency that meets a need or stands in for what is lacking.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 96:7 connection contrasts received sufficiency with the person seeing himself as self-sufficient.
branch_activations.activation: The contrast makes the focus's causative sufficiency contact a different kind of agency: the addressed person is made sufficient by an outside giver rather than enclosed in a self-claimed independence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The enrichment is received capacity for meeting need, not a declaration that the recipient has become independently self-sufficient.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not deny material wealth or import every meaning of the external ayah; it preserves only the supplied contrast.
